payload.reason: The evidence indicates that among the three pretraining tasks, Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective for improving performance in abstractive summarization tasks.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores on summarization datasets, indicating its superior performance.
The combination of all three tasks during training outperforms individual tasks, but SR still shows the best results overall.
